title: Fort Frederik
geometryBasis: Exact mapped outline of the fort building cross-referenced against the captioned NPS exterior photographs, National Historic Landmark building record, and unchanged terrain.
sectionBasis: Four wings surround a brick court. The west wing contains the two-storey Commandant’s Quarters, an arched passage and two court stairs. The low wings have flat decks with parapets. Red plaster is trimmed white, with shutters and alternating upper pediments.
limitations: Standing fort building only. The separately situated former stables, lower seaside outwork and movable displays are outside the mapped building boundary. Fine masonry, woodwork and smaller openings are approximated.
